description: This file contains a test factory class 'DbTestAppFactory' used for setting up an integration testing environment for the DataAssetBackend project. It configures a web application factory with database provisioning logic that prefers environment variable URLs, falls back to Dockerized PostgreSQL via Testcontainers if available, and handles setup of migrations and authentication tokens for tests. The class implements IAsyncLifetime for async initialization and disposal, and contains internal logic to determine the database setup method.

classes.name: DbTestAppFactory
classes.description: A sealed class inheriting from WebApplicationFactory<Program> that configures a test web host environment with optional PostgreSQL database setup, either via environment variable or Docker Testcontainers, including migration application and authentication token provisioning. Implements IAsyncLifetime for async initialization and cleanup.

methods.name: CreateAuthedClient
methods.description: Creates an HttpClient with default Authorization header set using the internal access token, and adds a fixed correlation ID header.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Overrides the base method to configure environment and services for testing, removing default database connection factories and injecting test database configuration.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Performs async setup: provisions a test database (via environment variable URL or Docker), applies migrations, and acquires an authentication token.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes of the PostgreSQL test container if initialized.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsAsync
methods.description: Executes SQL migration scripts in order against the provided connection string to set up the database schema.
